headline: Top 6 picnic spots in Delhi for a perfect day out
content: A tranquil green haven with roots in the 16th century, Sunder Nursery offers a delightful picnic spot surrounded by lush greenery. Spanning 90 acres and showcasing the grandeur of Mughal architecture, it is a beloved winter picnic spot for locals. This tranquil retreat is a favourite winter picnic spot, offering ample space to relax and enjoy quality time with loved ones amidst its lush surroundings. The historic landmarks, such as a Lodi-era mosque and tombs, make it a picturesque winter picnic spot, ideal for shadow photography and peaceful exploration. This destination is ideal for picnics. It features cafes, restaurants, and bars amidst lush greenery, making it a one-of-a-kind choice for a winter outing. This is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with iconic landmarks offering breathtaking views and showcasing the grandeur of the Mughal Empire.
